_about: The gold set of the assistants' evaluation (AI_ARCHITECTURE.md §9.2; ADR-0025 point 10). Each case is asked in English and in Russian, under one pair identifier. Expected evidence is named, never copied: an observation by indicator code, country, and year, as held in the World Bank snapshot of caipo/demo/data/worldbank; a demonstration passage by its document's title and its locator; a help section by its page and anchor. The questions were written for the evaluation and are not evidence. Verifier cases script the statements the support check is given, each with its known verdict.
